performance.verdict: Meta spend is zero for 28 days — contract limbo is killing the engine.

findings.text: Meta spend is $0 for all 28 tracked days; 0 leads generated. No paid activity is running whatsoever.
Contract extension with Marwan is open and unresolved; SOW flags this as a blocker gating the next 3 months of paid activity.
GBP actions dropped -100% in last 7 days; prior 7-day window shows 0 vs 28-day total of 142 actions, suggesting a listing or tracking disconnection.
Search Console clicks rose +30.22% week-over-week (534 clicks, 40,404 impressions over 28 days); organic is the only active channel and holding.
GHL shows 23 contacts and 0 opportunities created in 28 days; with zero paid leads, the pipeline is stalled — not an intake leak, just no top-of-funnel input.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan contract extension immediately; zero Meta spend for 28 days means zero leads and zero revenue progress.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has recorded $0 spend and 0 leads across all 28 tracked days — the paid engine is fully offline. The SOW flags the Marwan extension as an open blocker gating the next 3-month term. Sohib to escalate to Marwan for a signed decision by 2026-09-03. Success: extension confirmed, Meta campaigns reactivated at $65–75/day within 48 hours of signature.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing for tracking break; 28-day total shows 142 actions but last 7 days show 0 — likely a disconnection, not real drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell -100% in the last 7 days despite a 28-day total of 142 actions (48 calls, 94 web clicks), strongly suggesting a tracking or listing issue rather than a real traffic drop. Ops to verify GBP profile status, UTM/call-tracking configuration, and any listing suspensions by 2026-09-02. Success: GBP actions resume reporting above 5/day within 3 days of fix.

suggestions.text: Watch Search Console; clicks hit 43 on Aug 22 and 26 — confirm organic holds above 20 clicks/day through contract resolution.
suggestions.monday_update: Search Console clicks are the account's only active performance signal, up +30.22% week-over-week with recent daily highs of 43 clicks on Aug 22 and Aug 25.
